propositions: A non-epic parent divergence at emit time returns (False, None) byte-identical to an unbound-retry return, allowing the pass to exit successfully and report convergence while the hierarchy actually diverges, violating the project contract that divergence must be durably recorded.

Two live cells asserting sub-task parent round-trips were wrong oracles because DC accepts-and-ignores fields.parent on sub-tasks and rejects all nulling attempts, making those operations unsupported platform capabilities.

The re-home to Epic Link parents on non-sub-task children is already implemented and green on live instances, establishing that the user-visible contract (parent changes reach local or are loudly refused) is achievable through a supported mechanism.

When a user sets a parent the tracker cannot represent for a non-sub-task child, rebar must emit a durable outbound-field-dropped bridge alert instead of silently omitting the write, making the divergence operator-visible rather than invisible.
